blocks.text: Eviction Cleanout FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Eviction Cleanouts in Port Perry

items.q: 1. What does an eviction cleanout in Port Perry include?
a: An eviction cleanout involves removing unwanted furniture, appliances, household belongings, boxes, trash, and other non-hazardous items left behind by a former tenant. Our crew handles the lifting, loading, hauling, and final cleanup.

items.q: 2. What types of properties can you clean out after an eviction?
a: We provide eviction cleanouts for apartments, rental houses, condos, cottages, basements, garages, storage areas, and other residential properties throughout Port Perry and Scugog Township.

items.q: 3. What items can you remove during an eviction cleanout?
a: We can remove a wide range of common unwanted items, including: Sofas, chairs, tables, and cabinets Beds, mattresses, and dressers Refrigerators, stoves, washers, and dryers TVs and electronics Clothing, boxes, and household clutter Garage and basement contents Yard items and general non-hazardous debris

items.q: 4. Can you clean out an entire rental property after an eviction?
a: Yes. We can clear everything from a single room to an entire rental property. Our crew can work through bedrooms, kitchens, living areas, basements, garages, storage spaces, and other accessible areas.

items.q: 5. Do I need to move the items outside before your crew arrives?
a: No. You don’t need to carry or load anything yourself. Our crew handles the heavy lifting and removes eligible items directly from inside the property.
